style: Richly hand-painted stylized realism matching Image 1's Halloween suburban world: textured wood siding, slate shingles, weathered stone, fabric, metal, dense autumn foliage, softly modeled volumes and clear silhouettes. Smooth painted detail rather than pixel art or flat vector graphics.
palette: Deep navy and muted teal moonlit surfaces, rusty red and ochre autumn leaves, warm amber windows, orange jack-o-lanterns and practical bulbs. Preserve each asset's specified material colors within this palette.
lighting: Neutral moonlit exposure, cold blue light from upper-left, readable local material detail. Warm emission confined to actual windows, lanterns and pumpkin faces. Runtime supplies darkness, cast shadows, point-light falloff and fog.
projection: Orthographic 2:1 dimetric projection. One native tile is a 128x64 diamond. World X goes screen lower-right; world Y goes screen lower-left. Visible building faces are +X and +Y; doors/porches belong on +Y (lower-left).
avoid: HUD, menus, characters, screenshot borders, vignette, landscape/background, ground patches beneath props, cast shadows, atmospheric fog, bloom outside the silhouette, watermarks, invented text, clipped silhouettes, checkerboards painted into the image.
